text:
nora: quick huddle: we need a deterministic staging->GA signoff checklist that teams can run through and stamp. aiming for next Thurs.
ben: drop the checklist here and owners.
nora: rough minimal checklist: 1) SLOs+uptime agreed, 2) public quickstart + internal runbook, 3) oncall rota + two runbooks (rollback & latency mitig), 4) monitoring + 3 regression alerts, 5) pricing/quota mapping + migration notes, 6) private/dedicated appendix (KMS, audit logs), 7) rehearsed canary + automated smoke test.
ike: add explicit region failover rehearsal and DNS rehearse steps. last time DNS added 20m to RTO.
sophie: also call out model-variant fallback chain in the ops playbook (quantized -> fp16 -> smaller model). we should record expected quality delta per step.
legal-bot: note: include scheduled-maint exclusion (72h notice) and credit cap language. legal prefers a defined cap and a repeated-breach clause.
ben: suggested SLOs: p95 small <130ms, medium <320ms, large <550ms; data-plane uptime 99.95% (monthly). Is that ok commercially?
sophie: 99.95% may be ambitious for GA; commercial will accept 99.9% initially. but we can state 99.95% as aspirational target in internal docs.
nora: ok, public SLA will list 99.9% with a remediation ladder; internal ops doc can list 99.95% target. ben: agreed.
ike: operational rehearsal: smoke script path ./ci/ga_smoke.sh and runbook ./runbooks/dns_rehearse.md. smoke script should run N requests across two regions, flip region flag mid-run, assert fallback_rate <=5% and 5xx <=1.5%.
ben: I'll own the smoke job + dashboards. plan to add a GH action that runs smoke nightly against staging during the window.
sophie: I'll own SLO wording + fallback chain doc. will include a short table with expected latency delta and embedding-sim thresholds for quality fallbacks.
legal-bot: commercial draft: cap credits to either 1 month invoice or $75k, whichever is lower; repeated breaches (>=3 in 3 months) trigger an escalation path and possible contract review. will draft wording.
ora: monitoring/alerts: three regression alerts: token-cost/unit >=15% (pager), token-cost/unit 8-15% (ops-only), median latency increase >=20% over 30m (pager). also add a soft quality drift alert for embeddings.
ora: owners recap: smoke+dashboards (ben), SLO & fallback (sophie), legal + pricing cap (legal-bot), runbooks + oncall rota (nora), DNS rehearse (ike).
ike: infra note: ap-south has limited spare GPUs this week; for dual-region rehearsals consider alternate region pair or smaller synthetic token sizes. will coordinate.
ben: smoke script will accept --tokensize and --parallelism to avoid hogging GPUs. PR incoming.
sophie: also add automated cost-regression detector that compares 7d moving average to baseline and triggers a seeding investigation playbook. I will write the investigation steps.
ora: signoff group: PM, Eng lead, Infra lead, SRE, Legal. schedule provisional signoff meeting Thurs 4pm. drafts due Wed EOD.
legal-bot: reminder: include a one-paragraph data-retention and audit-log headline for private installs and note customer responsibility for key management in air-gapped setups.
ops-bot: incident note: earlier dedicated pilot had DNS TTL left high; recommend adding a TTL-change checklist to the DNS rehearse runbook.
ora: blockers?
ike: blocked on infra confirming a rehearsal window in staging for DNS test. pinging infra leads.
ben: blocked on runtime team for baseline p95 numbers for two large models. will ping runtime.
sophie: blocked on product input for acceptable quality delta thresholds during fallback; pinging evaluation team.
ora: thanks all. I'll synthesize a one-pager and drop into #shiproom once drafts hit PRs. add PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:
